name: Finger Millet (Ragi)
methodDescription: Harvested by hand, sun-dried on traditional mud floors, and hand-winnowed.
specimenCopy: Cultivated on the rain-shadow slopes of Attappady. This ancient grain is intensely nutrient-dense, harvested completely by hand by the Irula community.
offeringCopy: A resilient grain, a testament to endurance.

sensoryProfile.flavor: Deep, slightly malty, with a robust earthy backbone
